resources.string: Lets Jarvis read the Hearthpane screen you are on and point at its controls.

[{\"name\":\"hearthpane.screen_context\",\"description\":\"Describe the Hearthpane screen in front of the user as structured text (Control Center rooms and devices, Music now playing, the Settings page and its rows, Calls). No pixels or photos. Call it when the user asks what is on their screen or how to do something on it. Results carry target ids for hearthpane.highlight.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.highlight\",\"description\":\"Pulse one control on the Hearthpane screen in front so the user can see it. Use a target id from hearthpane.screen_context, then tell the user what to do with it.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"target\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A target id from hearthpane.screen_context, e.g. settings:immortal.settingsTheme or cc.room.kitchen.\"},\"hint\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A few words shown beside the control, e.g. Tap the switch.\"}},\"required\":[\"target\"]}}]
